authentication: Normal Cognito Authorization Code + PKCE; each run revoked its own session (HTTP 204)
decision: D-16 (owner, 7 October 2026): an event may only shorten the 24 hours promised to families; 1-24 hours per event.

compatibilityRelease.note: Refusal-only: the legacy body used the current value and the event-settings body named 25 hours; both were refused before any write. Retention was not shortened on staging, which could purge staging alert descriptions.

checks.copied: none: staging had no legacy override; the event value stays the 24-hour default at version 0 with no history

ordering: The reader release was pushed only after the compatibility image was the single running task, so no instance wrote the key to the legacy store after the copy.
limitations: eventName and the four platform-only keys remain legacy; AppSetting is not dropped. P10.8 and G3 remain open.
